data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Thursday, October 22, 2026: Crypto gains wiped out as oil prices stay over $111 a barrel
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $84,024.44 on Thursday, October 22, 2026, up 1.3% from Wednesday's open. As of 7:15 a.m. ET this morning, bitcoin moved all the way down to $81,809.90. Ethereum opened at $2,471.35, up 1% from Wednesday's opening price. The price of ethereum fell this morning to $2,400.36 as of 7:15 a.m. ET.
